title: Second jurisdiction content pack
context: After the pilot jurisdiction is stable and the M6 maintenance cadence is in place, the project may expand to a second jurisdiction. This is a backlog item gated on M6 completion and the expert-gated, license-verified process established in ops-019. It requires full license-vetting, snapshot pinning, and public-finance expert sign-off for the second jurisdiction's sources, following the same process as the pilot. This task must not be started until the first jurisdiction is stable.
objective: Identify, vet, snapshot, and generate the content pack for a second pilot jurisdiction following the same license-verification, snapshot-pinning, reconciliation, citation, neutrality, and expert-review process as the first jurisdiction — only after M6 is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Only started after M6 (ops-019) is complete and the pilot jurisdiction is stable
Full license-vetting per source: only open/PD/CC/open-gov licensed sources that permit derivatives enabled; no proprietary or paywalled data
Snapshot pinned (sha256) and full provenance recorded for all second-jurisdiction sources
Public-finance expert sign-off recorded for the second jurisdiction, snapshot-scoped
Content pack (dataset) produced following the same reconciliation, citation-coverage, neutrality-lint, and expert-review gates as the pilot
output: A second-jurisdiction content pack (dataset) with license-verified, checksummed sources, full provenance, public-finance expert sign-off, and reconciled/cited/neutrality-passed content following the same gates as the pilot jurisdiction.
